rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Carina Spire ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 1999).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 1999 as 'Carina Spire'.
rows.Bloom: Light pink, deep pink reverse. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
